<infobox theme="Company">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Organizational information</header>	
        <data source="founder"><label>Founder(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="ledby"><label>Leader(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="associations"><label>Associations</label></data>
        <data source="parent"><label>Parent company</label></data>
        <data source="subsid"><label>Subsidiaries</label></data>	
        <data source="headquarters"><label>Headquarters</label></data>	
        <data source="locations"><label>Location(s)</label></data>
        <data source="role"><label>Primary role(s)</label></data>
        <data source="products"><label>Major product(s)</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronological and political information</header>
        <data source="founding"><label>Founding</label></data>			
        <data source="dissolved"><label>Date dissolved</label></data>        
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Company|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
